88forn: Quentin "Ghost" Forn came up the line in the rain with a child's drawing of a horse and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Quentin "Ghost" Forn wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
filip_ogwanga: Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga came from Ashford Vale, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
